text:
marco: FYI team — planned regional DB switchover (primary -> warm-standby) in us-west on Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. Purpose: apply schema patch and validate automated failover path ahead of the holiday promo. No API downtime expected but there may be transient 5xxs and p99 latency jitter for a few minutes. :bell:

anya: How long is the promotion window? will write ops message for customers if needed.

marco: Window is 30m total. We expect the active failover to take <90s if clean. We'll run a small read-only loadtest immediately after to validate replication lag consistency.

jamal: Will this touch the control plane leader election or only data plane? need to know for routing guards.

marco: Only data plane DB primary change; control plane unaffected. Routing will remain but we're toggling the DB healthcheck to avoid automated throttles during the 5m convergence spike.

sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: regional-db-switchover-usw-3123456789. Reminder: oncall ack required 20m before start.

platform-pm: Proposal: temporary SLO relaxation on us-west token p99 from 1000ms -> 2200ms during 01:55-02:40 UTC. This avoids noisy rollbacks and lets the smoke tests run. Any objections?

anya: Support the SLO slice. Please ensure change is logged and auto-reverted. Also post the smoke test query list to the runbook.

jamal: I'll add a traffic shard to divert 10% of non-critical requests to secondary route for 5m during failover. That should limit customer impact.

marco: Nice. Runbook snippet (short):

```
# pre-checks
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/db-migrator -- /bin/check-replication.sh
# set health override
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/health/override -d '{"region":"us-west","state":"maintenance"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL'
# trigger switchover
psql -h db-primary-usw -c "SELECT switchover_to('db-standby-usw');"
# post-switchover verify
/opt/tools/wait_for_replica_sync --primary db-standby-usw --timeout 300
```

oncall-1: I'll be on pager and watching replication lag graph. Can someone add a synthetic that compares write-read delta?

jamal: Synthetic added: https://synthetics.internal/check/replica-lag-usw

marco: Ops note: if replication lag > 5s after 120s, run rollback: switchover-back and re-route traffic to previous primary. Rollback command: psql -h db-standby-usw -c "SELECT switchover_to('db-primary-usw-old');"

sre-bot: Temp SLO slice applied by ops: us-west token p99 -> 2200ms for window 01:55-02:40 UTC. Auto-revert scheduled at 02:40 UTC.

anya: I'll prepare a short internal broadcast for customer-facing teams: risk = low, expected customer impact = minimal, monitoring in place. No need for an external status page unless we hit >1% errors.

marco: Post-mortem criteria: open post-mortem if we see either >1% request error increase sustained >10m OR replication lag >10s at any time. Otherwise log to maintenance changelog.

oncall-1: Acked. Oncall will remain in the channel during the window.

jamal: Also note: this run requires a brief config flip on the read-replica autoscaler. I'll coordinate with eng-infra 30m prior.

marco: Thanks all — will ping at 30m, 10m, and 2m before start. Closing thread unless new blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
